# Gene Ho

> Web Application Manager at Scoot (a member of Singapore Airlines), based in Singapore. Leads web engineering across airline booking, payments and loyalty: 8+ squads, 20+ engineers. Started as a software engineer in 2015.

## Profile

- [Portfolio](https://geneho.github.io/): selected systems, ways of working and career
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/genehojj)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/geneho)
- [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/users/2737131/gene)

## Selected work at Scoot

- Payments: payments used to be a module built into each of 5 platforms (Booking, Manage My Booking, AgencyHub, Loyalty and other web platforms), so every payment update meant each one had to upgrade and redeploy. Moved payments to an in-house Hosted Payment Page, so payment updates now go out once. 14+ payment methods; FX and DCC brought in-house.
- Loyalty: paying for Scoot flights and add-ons with KrisFlyer miles (Award Chart, Spontaneous Escape). Millions of miles redeemed.
- B2B: overhauled Scoot AgencyHub so travel agents can do their everyday tasks from one place: bookings, tickets, agency credit top-ups, group travel, information and support. Helped steer it toward a one-stop portal; the team designed and built it.

## About

Naturally curious; likes bringing people and ideas together to fix real problems. Outside work: badminton, photography and travel.

## How I work

- Leading change: management set the goal of cross-platform squads. Helping the web engineers who report to me become cross-platform (web and mobile) developers: presented the plan at Product Council and secured two sprints of pair programming, started with small mobile tasks, and kept the timeline on track while clearing blockers.
- Sets the direction across booking, loyalty and B2B, turning business needs into a clear plan.
- Gives tech leads room to lead: joins design reviews and helps with decisions and dependencies between teams.
- Plans for go-live from the start: works with engineering, infrastructure and security teams; checks regression testing, security and support before a release.
- Brings in AI where it actually helps: an AI champion leads AI use in the team, and quality, rework and speed decide what is rolled out.

## Career

- 2023–now: Web Application Manager, Scoot
- 2022–2023: Engineering Manager, KrisShop
- 2020–2022: Technical Lead, KrisShop
- 2015–2020: Software engineering, ST Engineering and Keppel Logistics
